gpt-5.6-luna.basis: Public Standard short-context direct API list rates. Cache writes replace ordinary input, not an additional full charge.

representative_dawn_basis: Scenario: four-hour dawn window at 20-minute spacing including both endpoints. Uses whole-period mean token mix, not measured dawn-specific usage.
representative_day_basis: Scenario: rounded post-period observed mean 418/13=32.1538 reference calls per calendar-complete day; fixed at 32 for equal-work comparison, not a production schedule.
candidate_basis: Sensitivity assumptions only; neither achieved savings nor authority to alter outputs. Cache candidate uses measured peer cache tokens/call as a hypothetical target.
